alternatives: Enable all effects without a reviewed grant: rejected
counterevidence: General MCP successfully returns canonical Sa-plan status and capability inventory
Main Wisp service responds; failures are not a total outage
assumptions: Explicit bootstrap permits local development configuration, harness repair and tests
FMEA ratings are engineering judgments, not calibrated probabilities
decision.forecast: Within this session, tested read-only MCP tools and a reproducible baseline will be available; full mutation authority may remain blocked by coordinator lineage
decision.falsifier: An enabled observation mutates state, a false healthy claim survives acceptance, or a stale grant admits effects
acceptance: Initialized MCP canonical task and inventory reads pass, malformed plan requests fail
Existing harness focused tests execute and failures remain explicit
Fresh usable-service observations and source-bound recovery journal

Independent reviewed launcher grant and canonical coordinator reconciliation remain prerequisites for task effects

snapshot.reference: Bounded operator-approved recovery bootstrap; current listed bytes only, not whole-system admission

criticality.rationale: Operator requested a bounded policy update; this is not incident containment.

stpa.rationale: Conflicting selection guidance can omit critical constraints; runtime enforcement is not established.

fmea.rationale: False confidence in a policy-only gate is a major evidence failure; S4 O3 Det3 produces RPN36 and band4.

dependency.rationale: The common rule is consumed by all lifecycle and agent policy entry points.

impact.rationale: One shared policy improves consistent decisions across several development and operational roles.

scope: Explicit local development recovery bootstrap: read-only MCP configuration, harness diagnostics/tests and baseline reporting. No coordinator history writes, runtime restart, release, admission or external-tree mutation.

fmea_modes.cause: Selection criteria and authority claims diverge across guides.
fmea_modes.effect: Agents select unsafe or blocked work, or call unimplemented enforcement active.
fmea_modes.controls: Shared explicit policy; manual scope/authority checks; report-only validation; independent runtime admission later.
